sn55.31:1.2: Cattāro me bhikkhave puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā ||
sn55.31:1.4: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.31:1.5: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.31:2.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako Dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.31:2.2: Svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo || la-pe || paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī ti ||
sn55.31:3.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.31:3.2: supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho || pa-pe || anuttaram puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti ||
sn55.31:3.3: ayam tatiyo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassā hāro || || 6.
sn55.31:4.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi ||
sn55.31:4.3: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā ukhassāhārā ti || || 2.
